title: Raycast
description: A near-black keyboard-app dark: #07080a page, a ladder of cool greys for panels and hairlines (white at 5–10 %), white text with grey secondary copy, one coral red for the eyebrow, links and deep crimson light, and a white keycap button. Light is the same system on white. Inter for everything, Geist Mono for labels and small print.
notes: dark is the faithful mode (the original has no light mode); light is a sibling
highlight is the coral red (#ff6363); glow is the deep crimson used for the streak light
chart-1…5 are the extension-card tints: red, green, blue, yellow, indigo
